description: Copy a running or paused sandbox into count live copies, each with the parent's disk, memory and running processes as they were at the fork, and its own id; the parent carries on. Set a machine up once (clone, install, build, start a server), then fork it to try several approaches in parallel from the same state. Returns once every copy is running. All or nothing: if one cannot start, none is kept and the error says why. One machine holds about 7 copies of the default 4 vCPU shape (more of smaller ones). Copies bill and count against quotas like any sandbox, keep the parent's auto-pause and auto-delete, and on the free tier keep its deletion time.

labels.description: Labels for the copies, replacing the parent's (which they keep otherwise), at most 30. created-by=prized-sandbox-mcp and this install's prized-mcp-scope are always added; prized-mcp-scope cannot be passed.

sandbox_id.description: The running or paused sandbox to copy.

name: fork_sandbox

autoDeleteMinutes.description: Minutes after it pauses before it is deleted; 0 or null: kept until deleted.

autoPauseMinutes.description: Idle minutes before it pauses itself; 0 or null: never.

errorReason.description: Why it is in the error state, when it is.

expiresAt.description: When it is deleted (ISO 8601), or null.

maxRuntimeMinutes.description: Minutes of running before it is deleted.

state.description: starting, running, pausing, paused, resizing, deleting or error.

template.description: The template it was made from, such as prized-base-v1.

title: Fork a sandbox
